extension.title: 4. Browser Extension
extension.description: The WoT browser extension provides Web of Trust functionality for Nostr applications. By installing and using the extension, you agree to the following terms:

functionality.title: Functionality
functionality.description: The extension calculates trust scores based on your social graph and the Nostr protocol. Trust scores are subjective measures based on social connections and should not be considered absolute indicators of trustworthiness.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The extension may receive automatic updates through your browser's extension store. These updates may include bug fixes, security patches, and new features.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Sites

accuracy.title: Data Accuracy
accuracy.description: Trust calculations are based on publicly available Nostr data. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the data or calculations.

app.title: 6. Nostr WoT app (iOS and Android)
app.description: Nostr WoT signs Nostr requests for compatible apps. Connect your own node through LNbits or a wallet through Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC). The optional hosted wallet is a separate custodial service operated by DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY at zaps.nostr-wot.com: the company holds its funds.

selfCustody.title: Keys, unlocking and recovery
selfCustody.description: Private keys, wallet connection secrets, permissions, settings and activity are stored on your phone; keys are protected in an encrypted vault. Onboarding offers an automatic lock timer and a six-digit device PIN, with optional biometrics handled by the operating system. Choosing never to lock skips the PIN. We cannot reset your PIN or recover a lost seed phrase. Passkey recovery encrypts your seed phrase. New backups do not include account names, account lists or derivation paths; older backups may include them. Your credential provider can store the encrypted recovery copy. If you consent to relay storage, it can instead be published to Nostr relays. Recovery uses the provider and, when needed, configured recovery relays (currently nos.lol, relay.damus.io and nostr-01.yakihonne.com). Passkey availability and synchronization depend on your provider. Keep an independent recovery copy.

signing.title: What you sign
signing.description: You decide which apps may ask for signatures and what the app approves on its own. A signature made by the app counts as your own: check each request before you approve it, and set automatic approvals and payment limits with care.

hostedWallet.title: Hosted Lightning wallet (held by us)
hostedWallet.description: DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY holds the hosted wallet funds. The service stores your Nostr public key, wallet identifiers, balance, invoices, payment amounts, dates and status, claimed public Lightning address and NWC app connections with their limits. It processes network request data and operational logs to provide and secure the service. Wallet records remain while the wallet exists; we do not promise a fixed deletion period for operational logs or backups. The hosted service can move its funds, and access depends on its availability. Connecting another wallet does not by itself make that wallet self-custodial: custody depends on its operator. Remove an account in Accounts or use Delete all data in Settings to erase local app data. Move hosted funds out first and select the separate hosted-wallet deletion option; local erasure alone does not delete the server wallet. The deletion flow reports server failures. A completed hosted deletion removes the wallet, payment history, Lightning address, app connections and account association. If you no longer have the app, use our contact form to request deletion. Never send a seed phrase, private key, PIN or wallet connection secret.

externalWallets.title: Your own wallet (Nostr Wallet Connect)
externalWallets.description: Review signing requests, automatic approvals and payment limits. Keep recovery material safe and check the address and amount before sending. Wallet providers and relays have their own terms. The optional hosted wallet is custodial and depends on our service; move its balance before deleting it. We cannot reverse Lightning payments or restore keys without recovery material.

noAdvice.title: No financial advice
